feature: data-consolidation (ipos.open_date / close_date write path) for a postponed-then-relaunched issue
symptom: an IPO that was postponed and later relaunched with new dates keeps the FIRST attempt's open/close dates stored, because the relaunch arrives under a changed source record number (see `source-record-number-discarded`) and is not recognised as an update to the existing row, so the new dates never overwrite the stale ones.
first_seen: 2026-09-23: dhanwel-hybird-seeds-ltd close date stored as 2026-06-29 on staging (the postponed June attempt), while the live relaunch ran 19-21 Aug 2026 per BSE IPO_NO 7900 and Chittorgarh page 2846.
